valuationModel.comps: No listed comparable exists for an insured skill-prize platform. The multiple is set against what can be evidenced, not borrowed from US consumer-subscription comps.
valuationModel._multiplePolicy: One flat revenue multiple at every forward milestone (2026-08-04). The previous shape — 4.77x implied at entry, 2.74x at 2029, 6x at 2032 — dipped then spiked, which reads as three numbers picked to hit a target rather than a method. A single multiple is what an investor expects, and it means the milestones move only with revenue. Entry stays at whatever the round implies (R53.3m post / R11.2m revenue = 4.8x), so the multiple COMPRESSES as the company scales — the direction a sceptic expects.
valuationModel.multipleBasis: 3.0x revenue, flat at every forward milestone. The round implies 3.77x on 2027 forecast revenue, so the multiple compresses. No re-rating assumed anywhere.
valuationModel._horizonNote: The R1bn horizon was removed 2026-08-05 on the founder's instruction. It extended a subscriber growth rate to total revenue, which implied simulator attach reaching ~11.7% of all Korean rounds. Do not reinstate without a modelled basis.

insuranceModel._source: GetLucky_Insurance_Model.xlsx — the Santam underwriting submission. Reproduced independently 2026-08-05; every figure below ties to it.
insuranceModel._why: This is the reason the structure changed. A subscription that buys unlimited insured swings has premium fixed and exposure unbounded — at 16 par-3 attempts a month against a $10 subscription the cover runs at a loss ratio above 100%. Charging per entry collects the premium on the same swing that creates the risk, which is what makes it underwritable.
insuranceModel._breakeven: Aces would have to occur 2.51x more often than amateur odds predict before the cover stops making money.

engagement._note: Group-pooled: the fourball buys in together; four swings on one designated hole.

insuranceModel._structureNote: PURE per-entry structure, exactly the Santam submission: the subscription buys app access and carries ZERO prize risk; every insured swing is a separate paid entry with 24% ceded on that swing. The 2026-08-05 '4 included swings' blend was removed with the pivot — do not reinstate.
